title: 📖 Compound Words - Dvandva (द्वन्द्व समासः)
description: Learn to form and understand Dvandva compounds (coordinate compounds).

sections.title: 📖 What is Dvandva?
sections.content: Dvandva means 'pair'. It's a compound where all elements are equally important (like 'and' in English).

rules.name: Multiple Items
rules.example: राम + लक्ष्मण + सीता → रामलक्ष्मणसीताः (Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita)

examples.breakdown: सीता च रामः च (Sita and Rama)
देवाः ऋषयः पितरः भूतानि च (gods, sages, ancestors, and beings)
गुणः च दोषः च (merits and demerits)

questions.question: What is the compound for 'merits and demerits'?
questions.explanation: 'गुणदोषौ' = गुणः च दोषः च (merits and demerits).
